The given graph shows the income and expenditure of a family. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b2d6b2cf22087645bbf86501c72cbd08b0af7d450d32ac9da886ba9a854080a.png] 

The expenditure of the family increased by _____ from 2017 to 2018.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure of 2017 = 80000

Expenditure of 2018 = 100000

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure increased from 2017 to 2018 = (Expenditure of 2018 - Expenditure of 2017)/(Expenditure of 2017) times 100

**Calculation:**

Expenditure increased from 2017 to 2018 = (100 -80)/(80) times 100

⇒ (20)/(80) times 100

⇒ 25 %

**∴ The expenditure of the family increased by 25 % from 2017 to 2018**

The following bar graph shows the production of various models of mobiles in the year 2019 and 2020. The total production is 40 lakhs during 2019 and 65 lakhs in 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fde08c1ee029fffa45732d97b207421697f3e000c5d1defd25b7d80d97e51f8.png] 

What is the total production of model A mobiles in 2020 and model E mobiles in 2019?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The following bar graph shows the production of various models of mobiles in the year 2019 and 2020.

The total production is 40 lakhs during 2019 and 65 lakhs in 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fde08c1ee029fffa45732d97b207421697f3e000c5d1defd25b7d80d97e51f8.png] 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

The total production of model A mobiles in 2020 = 40% of 65 lakhs = 0.40 × 65 lakhs = 26 lakhs

The total production of model E mobiles in 2019 = 15% of 40 lakhs = 0.15 × 40 lakhs = 6 lakhs

The total production of model A mobiles in 2020 and model E mobiles in 2019 = 26 lakhs + 6 lakhs = 32 lakhs

**∴ The total production of model A mobiles in 2020 and model E mobiles in 2019 is 32,00,000.**

questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Population in 2006 = 9.5 lakhs

⇒ Population in 2007 = 11.4 lakhs

⇒ Increase in population from 2006 to 2007 = 11.4 – 9.5 = 1.9

⇒ Percentage increase in population from 2006 to 2007 = (1.9)/(9.5) × 100 = (100)/(5) = 20%

**Therefore, the percentage increase in population from 2006 to 2007 is 20%.**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

No. of employees recruited in 2017 = 500

No. of employees recruited in 2018 = 1000

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = frac{{Increase in recruitment}}{{Recruitment in 2017}} times 100

What was the approximate percentage profit margin on revenue of company Z in 2016?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sales in 2016 = Rs. 2057 cr

Profit in 2016 = Rs. 847 cr

**Concept and Formula used:**

Profit Margin Percentage = (Profit / Sales) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit Margin Percentage = (847 / 2057) × 100

⇒ Profit Margin Percentage ≈ 0.4118 × 100

⇒ Profit Margin Percentage ≈ 41.18%

**∴ The approximate percentage profit margin on revenue of company Z in 2016 is 41.18%.**

questions.question:
The following bar graph shows the sales (in thousand numbers) of scooters from six different companies in 2011 and 2012.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eac794c861051391563bac25635c42c650615330bf85b50b12cb5ee8fdbab7c.png] 

The average sales of companies A and E in 2011 is what percentage of the average sales of companies B and D in 2012?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Sales of companies B and D in 2012 = 18000 + 21000 = 39,000

⇒ Sales of companies A and E in 2011 = 11000 + 18000 = 29,000

⇒ Percentage composition = (29000)/(39000)times 100

⇒ Percentage composition = (29)/(39)times 100 = 74.36%

**Therefore, the average sales of companies B and D in 2012 is 74.36% of average sales of companies A and E in 2011.**

questions.question:
The following bar graph indicates the demand and production (in hundreds) of 5 companies A, B, C, D and E. X-axis indicates the demand and production (in hundreds) and Y-axis indicates the companies. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question that follows. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891bb35e657d4d255aa19eae8fddac8fb8e7afeec1c956b0ae46b4ff0efab0b0.png] 

Find the difference between the average demand and average production of the five companies taken together.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Corrected demand and production values for companies
 A, B, C, D, and E.

**Values:**

Company A: Demand = 35, Production = 30

Company B: Demand = 25, Production = 40

Company C: Demand = 30, Production = 25

Company D: Demand = 30, Production = 40

Company E: Demand = 40, Production = 45

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of values) / (Number of values)

**Calculations:**

Sum of demands = 35 + 25 + 30 + 30 + 40 = 160

Sum of production = 30 + 40 + 25 + 40 + 45 = 180

Average demand = 160 / 5 = 32

Average production = 180 / 5 = 36

Difference between average demand and average production:

⇒ 36 - 32 = 4

**∴ The difference between the average demand and average production of the five companies is 400 units.**
